notes: Background: zero-to-one devtools startup building an IDE copilot that is repo-aware. Primary value prop: precise, context-rich completions without leaking unrelated code across repos.
Quote from CTO (call): 'We need completions that respect repo boundaries and residency. Can't risk EU customer code landing in a US-only vector DB.'
POC scope: ingest 3 active repos (monorepo + two service repos), daily incremental embedding updates, compare Pinecone-managed vector DB vs in-cluster FAISS + IVF quantization.
Key ask: low-latency streaming in-IDE (first-byte <100ms, steady-state <50ms) and model pinning per org/workspace so we can roll forward safely.
Residency: EU customers require embeddings and index storage in eu-west region; DevCompass needs policy for route-by-region and a private deployment option for large enterprise accounts.
Chunking notes: prefer function/AST-aware chunking to keep context windows efficient and avoid truncating method signatures. Also want semantic hashing for dedupe during indexing.
Quality vs Cost: product team willing to accept slightly higher per-token cost for LLM context fidelity but needs Redwood Optimize suggestions to tune quantization and batching.
Operational: infra asked about KV cache eviction tied to branch/commit lifecycle; they run many short-lived feature branches and want to avoid stale context hits.
Security: legal asked for audit logs (index writes, query logs) retention policy and ability to forward logs to customer SIEM. Also request for HSM/KMS integration details.
Blocking items: legal wants explicit data residency clause, infra needs a vetted VPC peering playbook, and engineering wants deterministic model fallback behavior documented.
